notice: Demonstration guidance requiring clinical review before production use.
emergencyCallInstruction: Call 112 now and report heavy bleeding.
doActions: Use a clean cloth to apply firm, continuous pressure to the wound.
Keep pressure in place while waiting for help.
doNotActions: Do not remove an object embedded in the wound.
Do not give food, drink, or medicine.
escalationRule: Tell the 112 operator if bleeding continues or the person becomes less responsive.
